svg.text: Main-only demo: Pod A and Pod B concurrency
1,200 randomized success records; Pod A=16 permits; Pod B=8 permits; each panel scaled to its limit
Main worker A (16 permits) - 590 successful handlers, peakActive=13 / limit=16
Main worker B (8 permits) - 610 successful handlers, peakActive=8 / limit=8
Source: one Docker log file per main-worker replica; activeAtStart is pod-local. Red dashed line: configured concurrency limit.
